Built from two CC0 characters of the Quaternius Ultimate Modular Men Pack that share one 62-joint rig: the 'SWAT' torso, arms, gloved hands and boots (recoloured as a charcoal riding jacket with a black armour vest and full black gloves) and the 'Casual Character' jeans. The head was replaced by a full-face helmet modelled for this project (red shell, white centre stripe, dark smoked visor with side pivots, chin vent, black rim, closed underneath) over a black neck gaiter. Posed in Blender 4.1 with a scripted IK/FK solver and baked into static meshes (armature applied, skeleton and clips removed): pelvis on the seat, about 32 deg forward lean with a straight back, head up (5 deg nose-down), elbows bent about 36 deg and slightly out, fingers solved to wrap the 2.8 cm grips, knees against the tank, heels up. The pack's stylised arms were about 20 % too short to reach the bars, so the arms were lengthened in the rest pose (upper arm x1.55, forearm x1.15) before posing. Checked against bike.glb from the side, front, top and chase views: nothing shows through the bike. The only overlaps are hidden: the grips pass through the closed fists, the inner thighs press up to 3 cm into the tank's rear corners and the jeans sink up to 2 cm into the front of the seat; the knees touch the tank (under 3 mm). Game code: src/assets.js wraps bike.glb's scene ('inner') in a group and scales it by 1.95/2.1155 = 0.922 and re-centres it, so add a clone of the rider to that inner scene (vehicleRoot.children[0]), not to the wrapper, and set castShadow on its meshes. Show it only while the player rides. The first-person seat camera ([-0.25, 1.5, 0] in wrapper units) sits just behind the helmet, so hide the rider (or at least Rider_Helmet) in first person, or move that camera to the eye point (0.056, 1.63, 0), which is (0.05, 1.50, 0) in wrapper units. notes: Hero car for the Gate 1 bay (src/game/vehicles.js spawnPrius). Source choice: the Open Robotics car_demo Prius (github.com/osrf/car_demo, prius_description/meshes; package.xml says Apache 2.0, the repo has no LICENSE file; the same model is CC0 on Gazebo Fuel as OpenRobotics/Prius Hybrid) was rejected: it is the 4th-generation XW50 (2016) body, 2.2k triangles with 76-triangle wheels. The Webots Prius is licensed for use only with Webots, and poly.pizza / OpenGameArt have no Prius. The only clean, permissively licensed XW30 found without a login is this CC-BY model (pre-facelift 2010-2011 front), so it was used. Provenance caveat: the licence is the one the uploader declared on Sketchfab; the part names (boot_ok, bonnet_ok, chassis_hi, ...) suggest it was converted from a game-mod rig, and the original authorship could not be verified independently. Changes: baked the Sketchfab node transforms (131 mirrored nodes; the winding follows the mirror and the author's normals were kept), turned the nose to +X, scaled x0.5552 to 4.46 m long, put the origin on the ground between the axles, split the four wheels (tyre + rim + disc) into pivoted nodes, re-authored every material as PBR (19 materials, 28 primitives = draw calls), recoloured the white paint to Blue Ribbon Metallic, turned the black lamp covers into a clear lens over chrome reflectors (headlights) and red lenses (tail lights), removed the floating Berlin plate letters 'B MM 7125' and added 520 x 110 mm number plates with runtime-canvas UVs and a made-up fallback texture ('PR-010-US'), decimated the cabin from 25.9k to 7k triangles (steering wheel 8.9k to 0.9k), and baked ambient occlusion in Cycles (2048 px, 256 samples, 0.5 m reach; body occluded by the ground, wheels and cabin; wheels self-occlusion only because they spin). The AO rides in the base-colour texture because spawnPrius rebuilds Paint as a MeshPhysicalMaterial that keeps color and map but drops aoMap. Lamps: HeadLight and TailLight have black emissive in the file; the game sets the colour and intensity (0xfff4e0 x3, 0xff1a0a x0.15 / x4 braking). Avoid 'brake' in any other material name: spawnPrius treats /taillight|brake/i as a tail light. All materials are double-sided, as in the source. Checked from all sides and from below: no flipped faces (winding agrees with the normals on 100 % of faces), no visible gaps; the only coincident faces are a few cm2 inside the door cavities. Limits: slightly wavy reflections on the bonnet nose (source mesh), emblem discs have no logo, doors and bonnet are not separate.
